title: Buddy Rich with the Machito band
summary: Rich and the bongos traded four bars.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Uh-huh. How about Buddy Rich? How did he fit in?

Well, just like I told you. We had a -- we split things, like you play up to here, start the band. You get a solo. And then it's like a conversation. Now, Buddy BONGO would play something, four bars; you answer.
Uh-huh. So you were trading fours.
Like that, beautiful. I never put the two together, playing for the band. I knew (inaudible) playing drum would never be A RIGHT. (inaudible). The four beat can be a contrast.
